description: This file defines classes for handling ZIPL configuration commands in a kickstart setup, specifically for s390x architecture, including options for secure boot configuration.

classes.name: F32_Zipl
classes.description: Class representing ZIPL configuration command for s390x architecture with secure boot options.

classes.name: RHEL8_Zipl
classes.description: Subclass of F32_Zipl, potentially for RHEL8 specific ZIPL configurations.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the ZIPL command with optional secure boot setting.

methods.name: _getParser
methods.description: Creates and returns an argument parser for ZIPL command options.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments and sets internal state accordingly.

methods.name: __str__
methods.description: Returns string representation of the ZIPL command, including configuration if set.

methods.name: _getArgsAsStr
methods.description: Generates command-line argument string based on secure boot configuration.
